sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. sources.title: TigreGotico/Plume32k-onnx · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: ONNX export of projecte-aina/Plume32k, a 2B parameter translation model from Projecte AINA at the Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC). The model is Catalan-centric: it was trained only on Catalan-centric parallel data, and it covers 16 supervised directions plus 56 zero-shot directions.
